snippet.title: The 19-Year Old Ranger Who Refused To Quit
snippet.description:
Jeff Struecker shares one of the most unforgettable acts of courage he witnessed during the Battle of Mogadishu.

Brad Paulson was less than a year removed from high school when he found himself on top of a Humvee in Somalia, running a .50 cal in the middle of a brutal firefight.

After taking shrapnel to the hand and a round across the forehead, Brad refused to come off the gun.

That is the kind of courage that defines an Army Ranger.

snippet.title: The REAL Reason Satan Hates Israel & the Jewish People | End Times Prophecy
snippet.description:
Rabbi Jason Sobel sits down with Chad Robichaux to unpack one of the most misunderstood topics in modern Christianity: why the Jewish people have been persecuted for millennia, what the Bible actually says about Israel in the end times, and where the line sits between legitimate criticism of the Israeli government and outright antisemitism.

Rabbi Jason opens with a perspective most Christians have never heard, the persecution of the Jewish people is satanic at its root. Satan can't get to God, so he goes after God's children, the same way the mafia or the cartels go after a man's family when they can't get to him directly. That's why Pharaoh tried to kill the Jewish babies. That's why Herod slaughtered the innocents. Kill the promised seed. Stop the Messiah. And according to Rabbi Jason, that same spiritual war is still playing out today, because Jesus Himself said He would not return until the Jewish people welcome Him with the Hebrew blessing "Baruch haba b'shem Adonai."

The conversation moves into territory most pastors won't touch: the 144,000 from the 12 tribes of Revelation, why there were 12 Jewish apostles, the double standard of a world that screams about Israel while staying silent on Iran, Syria, Afghanistan, and the global martyrdom of Christians and why Rabbi Jason believes anti-Israel sentiment has become the "gateway drug" that nefarious forces are using to pull young Christians and conservatives into leftist ideology and radical Islam, dismantling the Judeo-Christian foundation the West was built on.

Chad pushes in on the nuance most people miss: you can love Israel and still not like Netanyahu. You can criticize a government without hating a people. And he and Rabbi Jason walk through exactly when criticism crosses the line into antisemitism, libel, conspiracy theories, denying the biblical promise, and holding Israel to a standard you refuse to hold any other nation to.
If you've ever felt confused about Israel, the Jewish people, end times prophecy, or how to talk about any of it without sounding like a crazy person — this is the conversation.

snippet.description:
🌱 https://independentbackyard.com/my-book/#aff=natanaelfernamdes
 — The complete design and construction guide for a $150 DIY greenhouse that extends your growing season by 6 months — any backyard, any climate, zero construction experience required
The growing season ends every year and most households accept that ending as fixed — transitioning fully back to the grocery system for five to seven months while the garden infrastructure they spent a season building sits dormant and contributes nothing to their food supply. A $150 greenhouse built correctly changes this completely, converting those dormant months into the most financially productive period of the food production year — because winter greens at retail in January and February are among the most expensive fresh produce categories in any grocery store, and a household producing its own from a protected growing environment is replacing the most expensive food at retail with the cheapest food to produce at home.
In this video we cover the complete design, construction, and operation of a DIY winter greenhouse at the $150 price point. Why polycarbonate twin-wall panels outperform plastic film for overnight heat retention and why this single material choice is what separates a greenhouse that grows through deep winter from one that provides only marginal frost protection. Why thermal mass — dark-painted water containers positioned along the north wall — is the difference between a structure that loses its solar heat gain overnight and one that maintains growing temperatures through the coldest winter nights without any supplemental heating. The three configuration options — lean-to against an existing south-facing wall, freestanding hoop house, and individual raised bed cold frames — with the specific material list dimensions and construction sequence for each. The cold-hardy crops that perform most effectively in an unheated winter greenhouse — kale spinach arugula mache claytonia and winter lettuce varieties — and why they produce food of exceptional quality and exceptional financial value in cool winter conditions. The spring extension dimension that starts warm-season crops four to six weeks earlier than outdoor conditions would allow — adding the same amount of growing time to the spring end of the season that the winter growing adds to the fall end. And why the $150 greenhouse is the component that converts a seasonal food production system into a genuinely year-round one — completing the seasonal coverage that stored preservation food extends while adding the fresh production dimension that preserved food cannot replicate.
The complete build guide — three configurations, full material lists, thermal mass installation, winter crop schedules by climate zone, and spring extension management — is linked above.

Every household in the country is throwing away money every single day.
 Not metaphorically. Literally discarding living plant material that regenerates into the same food it came from at zero additional cost — from the same kitchen where the household already operates, without any specialized knowledge, any significant time investment, or any equipment beyond what most households already own. The bottom of a celery bunch. The root end of green onions. The base of a romaine lettuce head. The sprouting heel of a garlic bulb. These are not waste products. They are living material that retains the capacity to generate new growth — in some cases for weeks, in some cases for months, in some cases indefinitely.
In this video we cover all twelve kitchen scraps that regenerate most reliably and most productively, divided into three categories — water regenerators that produce harvestable food within five to fourteen days on any kitchen windowsill, soil regenerators that develop into full productive plants from materials heading to the trash, and outdoor soil producers that transition from indoor starts into full seasonal harvests in any available growing space. We break down exactly why green onion roots produce three to four full harvest cycles from a single store-bought bunch before the root system is exhausted, how a single sprouted garlic clove planted in soil produces full garlic greens in two weeks and a complete garlic head by end of season, why the managed rotation of all twelve materials simultaneously produces a measurable weekly reduction in grocery spending from inputs that cost nothing because they are generated automatically by normal daily cooking, and why the direct experience of cutting fresh green onions on Friday from roots that were heading to the trash on Monday is the specific moment that changes how most households think about what home food production actually requires.
The complete setup guide for all twelve — water depth, soil type, light requirements, harvest timing, rotation schedule, and outdoor transition protocol — is linked above.

snippet.title: Julian Dorey Spent $7,000 On His Podcast Before The World Shut Down
snippet.description:
Julian Dorey turned down a lucrative Wall Street offer because "banks are where creativity goes to die," then spent every dollar he had on podcast equipment that arrived the first day of COVID quarantine. His dad's phone call changed everything: "This isn't going to be two weeks. This is going to be a year." From a makeshift studio in his parents' back room in South Jersey, Julian built The Julian Dorey Podcast into a powerhouse with over a million followers.

In this clip from The Resilient Show, Julian sits down with Chad Robichaux to talk about the moment he bet everything on himself, what COVID was really like at ground zero in North Jersey, and why looking back on the pandemic response, he believes people in business and government "knew damn well" it wasn't what they were advertising.
